summary: ACPAssessmentCombined is an integrated assessment file for evaluating physiotherapy students in Canadian clinical placements. It follows the Canadian Physiotherapy Assessment of Clinical Performance (ACP) form, mapping to the Essential Competency Profile for Physiotherapists. The system captures multi-role competencies and tracks student performance at midterm and final points. It utilizes rating scales, anchor descriptors, and structured comment fields, integrating assessor and student evaluations. The workflows facilitate stepwise assessment aligned to distinct physiotherapist roles and competencies.
purpose: To provide an evidence-based, standardized, multi-role assessment of physiotherapy student performance during clinical placements, supporting formative and summative evaluation, informing grading and remediation, and contributing to regulatory compliance and clinical education quality assurance.

workflows.name: ACP Combined Assessment Workflow
steps: Access instructions and background via WSInstructions
Review rating scales and anchor descriptors (WSDefinitions)

Complete multi-step Wizard assessment: 1.0 Expert Assessment, 1.0 Expert Analysis, 1.0 Expert Intervention, 2.0 Communicator, 3.0 Collaborator, 4.0 Manager, 5.0 Advocate, 6.0 Scholarly Practitioner, 7.0 Professional, Summative Comments, Submit, Complete
For each step: All assessors provide ratings (Likert scale) and comments for each section and question
Midterm and Final points captured and displayed separately
Comments and areas of concern noted on each role/section
Summative comments, days absent, extra hours worked, and overall recommendation provided
Submission triggers grading workflow, faculty review, and final grade assignment

business_rules: All criteria within an anchor must be demonstrated for scoring at a level
Performance with Distinction requires demonstration of primary criteria plus at least one additional
Assessment must be performed at both midterm and final points
Areas of strength and improvement must be substantiated with comments
If not applicable, rationale must be stated in comments
All rating scales and comment fields must be completed for required sections
Assessor and student ratings must be differentiated and tracked
Final assessment is only valid if status is 'Submitted'
validations: Student must demonstrate all anchor criteria for selected rating
Comments required for areas of strength and improvement
Numeric fields (days absent, extra hours) validated for numeric entry
Sections flagged incomplete if required answers missing
Data entered must correspond to regulatory guidelines for privacy and consent
calculations: Caseload percentage based on anchor definitions (beginner, intermediate, distinction, etc.)
Summary grading determination (Credit, Credit with reservation, No Credit)
Tracking days absent and extra hours for compliance and summary
Rating scale aggregation by section and role
conditions: Assessment can be midterm or final
If performance is below expectations, 'Credit with reservation' or 'No Credit' can be recommended
Sections or fields not applicable must be justified
Only 'Submitted' status final assessments are counted for grading
system_behavior: Wizard UI guides assessors through sequential steps
SideBar navigation allows step selection and completion flag visibility
Assessment answers are stored per section, assessor, and assessment type
On submission, system triggers faculty review and grading process
System supports read-only view when status is 'Submitted' or user is view-only
dependencies: AssessmentSection structure reflects Essential Competency Profile roles
Links to external education modules for assessor preparation
Assessment answers depend on user role and status
Rating scale anchors and descriptors licensed from American Physical Therapy Association
exceptions: Sections may be skipped or justified if not applicable
Errors shown if required questions or options are missing
Assessment not accepted if incomplete or not 'Submitted'
System displays warning/error panels for missing/incomplete fields
content_gaps: Assessment results and actual student performance data are not present; only structure, fields, and rules.
No business process integration details (e.g., downstream reporting, analytics, LTI, etc.).
No explicit system error handling/notification mechanisms beyond UI warnings.
No implementation code for database writes or GitHub integration.
